title: Figure 8.40 Lay out; Style (Figure 8.41); Title step
headingUrdu: شکل ۸.۴۰ لے آؤٹ؛ اسٹائل (شکل ۸.۴۱)؛ ٹائٹل کا مرحلہ

paras.en: Select the Style for the report. As shown in Figure 8.41. Click Next.
paras.ur: رپورٹ کے لیے اسٹائل منتخب کریں۔ جیسا کہ شکل ۸.۴۱ میں دکھایا گیا ہے۔ نیکسٹ پر کلک کریں۔
paras.ps: د راپور لپاره Style وټاکئ. لکه څنګه چې ۸.۴۱ انځور کې ښودل شوی. Next کلیک کړئ.

paras.en: Give Title to the report (like Student) and then click Finish, as shown in Figure 8.42.
paras.ur: رپورٹ کو عنوان (جیسے اسٹوڈنٹ) دیں اور پھر فنش پر کلک کریں، جیسا کہ شکل ۸.۴۲ میں دکھایا گیا ہے۔
paras.ps: راپور ته سرلیک (لکه Student) ورکړئ او بیا Finish کلیک کړئ، لکه څنګه چې ۸.۴۲ انځور کې ښودل شوی.

sourceNote: Printed page 291: Figure 8.40 Lay out (the wizard dialog with the options Columnar, Tabular, Justified, Portrait and Landscape and the checkbox “Adjust the field width so all fields fit on a page”; redrawn as simplified coded SVG), the step on the Style, Figure 8.41 Lay out (the style list Access 2007, Apex, Aspect, Civic, Concourse, Equity, Flow, Foundry, Median, Metro, Module, None, Northwind and the preview with Title, Label above Detail and Control from Detail; the caption is printed “Lay out” again as in the print) and the step on the Title (Figure 8.42 follows on the next page). The words Style, Next, Title and Finish are printed in bold. Screenshots are not reproduced; each screenshot is redrawn as simplified coded SVG with the legible printed labels. Watermark, border lines, page-edge shadows and handwriting are excluded.
